req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject a player creation request with a duplicate squad number by returning an HTTP 409 Conflict status. This ensures data integrity by preventing duplicate entries for squad numbers, which are unique identifiers for players within a team. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful player creation, a negative test to check for duplicate squad number rejection, and a boundary test to ensure the system handles edge cases correctly.

tests.name: test_create_player_success
preconditions: The player database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
No player exists with squad number 27.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a new player having squad number 27.
expected: The response contains the new player's data with squad number 27.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

new_player = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=new_player)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["squadNumber"] == 27

tests.name: test_create_player_duplicate_squad_number
preconditions: The player database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
A player exists with squad number 10.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a new player having squad number 10.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating a duplicate squad number.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

duplicate_player = {
    "firstName": "Duplicate",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=duplicate_player)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()["detail"]
